title: pod-2A-topic-planner scoring model
description: Validates references/scoring-model.json - the canonical 10-signal scoring model for podcast topic selection. INVARIANT NOT ENFORCEABLE HERE: the sum of every signals[].weight must equal 1.00 (tolerance 0.001). JSON Schema cannot sum values across an array, so this cross-field invariant is checked by scripts/validate-scoring-model.py, which validates against this schema AND asserts the weight sum. Always run that validator after editing scoring-model.json - passing this schema alone is not sufficient.

_meta.description: Provenance and invariants for the scoring model.

version.description: Semantic version of the scoring model.

last_updated.description: ISO date of the last edit.

purpose.description: What this file is and how it is consumed.

status.description: Lifecycle status note (e.g. SPEC vs wired).

invariants.description: Hard rules the model must satisfy. weights_sum_to + tolerance are enforced by scripts/validate-scoring-model.py, not by this schema.

weights_sum_to.description: Target sum of all signal weights.

tolerance.description: Allowed floating-point drift on the weight sum.

optional_signal_handling.description: How a missing optional signal's weight is redistributed at runtime.

buckets.description: Named scoring buckets. Each property key is a bucket id referenced by signals[].bucket.

signals.description: The scoring signals. Every signal's weight contributes to a sum that must equal 1.00 (checked by validate-scoring-model.py).

bucket.description: Bucket this signal belongs to. Must match a key in the top-level buckets object - cross-checked by validate-scoring-model.py.

evidence_family.description: Independent evidence family used for corroboration (e.g. entity, search-demand, trend, competitive).

definition.description: Plain-language definition of what the signal measures.

source.description: Data file or report the signal is computed from.

normalization.description: How the raw value is normalized to 0-1.

weight.description: Signal weight, 0-1. Sum of all signal weights must equal 1.00 (tolerance 0.001).

optional.description: True if the signal can be absent at runtime; its weight then redistributes across present signals.

absent_when.description: Condition under which the signal is missing, and the fallback behavior.

corroboration.description: Cross-family convergence rules. Sets a confidence flag and an optional ranking floor; does not alter the numeric score.

description.description: What corroboration is and why it matters.

additionalProperties.description: A single evidence family's firing rule.

fires_when.description: Condition under which this family fires.

optional.description: True if this family may be absent at runtime.

levels.description: Ordered corroboration levels from strongest to weakest.

flag.description: Flag value emitted at this level.

ranking_floor.description: Optional protection that keeps corroborated topics in the main set.

enabled.description: Whether the ranking floor is active.

score_margin.description: Maximum authority_score gap a corroborated topic may rise across when promoted past a non-corroborated topic. Bounds the floor to near-ties so it never becomes a global re-sort.

rule.description: The floor rule in plain language.

rationale.description: Rules that generate the Rationale column text from signal scores plus the corroboration flag.

description.description: What the rationale text is and what it must convey.

rules.description: Ordered rules for composing the rationale text.
